description.value: Cahilty Lodge is a 168-room condominium-style hotel and the first accommodation built at Sun Peaks Resort, situated centrally in the ski and bike village just steps from shops and restaurants. Rooms range from traditional lodge rooms with two queen beds to spacious three-bedroom suites, all with heated tile bathroom floors. The lodge is well-suited to self-supported touring cyclists with dedicated secure parkade bike storage and coin-operated guest laundry on-site.

address.value: 3220 Village Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is detailed and authoritative: Cahilty Lodge is a 168-room condominium-style hotel at Sun Peaks Resort managed by Bear Country Property Management — not an alpine hut as OSM tags suggest, and the OSM operator 'Kamloops Snowmobile Association' also appears wrong. The amenities page explicitly confirms a secure bike storage room in the parkade accessed by room key only, with a smaller overflow room, and front desk staff lending equipment locks — together satisfying the secure storage and staff-knowledge criteria. Wi-Fi ('free WiFi available throughout the hotel'), coin-op laundry (fourth floor), and village-central proximity to restaurants are all confirmed directly from the website.
concerns: OSM tags this record as tourism=alpine_hut, which is incorrect — the website confirms a full-service 168-room condominium-style hotel.
OSM operator tag 'Kamloops Snowmobile Association' appears incorrect; the website identifies the operator as Bear Country Property Management (2018) Ltd.
OSM record contains no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed fields for phone and address are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-equipped resort hotel with explicitly confirmed key-card-secured bike storage, coin-op laundry, free Wi-Fi, and village-central location — clear value for touring cyclists visiting Sun Peaks.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Amenities page: 'a large storage room for skis, boards and bikes, as well as a smaller overflow room... in the west end of the parkade with access using your room key only.'

Laundry.detail: Fourth-floor guest laundry room with coin-operated washing and drying machines; detergent purchasable from front desk

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states lodge is 'steps away from everything you need in the village' including 'amazing shops and restaurants'; site includes a dedicated Dining section for Sun Peaks Village

Staff know the bike procedure.detail: Front desk staff lend ski locks to guests ('You may borrow a ski lock from the front desk free of charge'), confirming staff engagement with the equipment storage system

wow_evidence: dedicated secure parkade bike storage and coin-operated guest laundry on-site
